33: private[writer] final class BufferedFileChannelWriter(channel: FileChannel, bb: ByteBuffer) extends AutoCloseable with StrictLogging {
34: 
35:   // we must start at 1 because we use the opposite value for a cache hit
36:   // but as -0 == 0, it would always result on a cache miss on the read side
37:   private var stringCacheCurrentIndex = 1
38:   private val stringCache = new ju.HashMap[String, jl.Integer]
39: 
40:   def flush(): Unit = {
41:     bb.flip()
42:     while (bb.hasRemaining) {
43:       channel.write(bb)
44:     }
45:     bb.clear()
46:   }
47: 
48:   private def ensureCapacity(i: Int): Unit =
49:     if (bb.remaining < i) {
50:       flush()
51:     }
52: 
53:   def writeByte(byte: Byte): Unit = {
54:     ensureCapacity(jl.Byte.BYTES)
55:     bb.put(byte)
56:   }
57: 
58:   def writeBoolean(boolean: Boolean): Unit =
59:     writeByte(if (boolean) 1 else 0)
60: 
61:   def writeBytes(bytes: Array[Byte]): Unit = {
62:     ensureCapacity(jl.Integer.BYTES + bytes.length)
63:     bb.putInt(bytes.length)
64:     bb.put(bytes)
65:   }
66: 
67:   def writeByteBuffer(src: ByteBuffer): Unit = {
68:     ensureCapacity(jl.Integer.BYTES + src.remaining)
69:     bb.putInt(src.remaining)
70:     bb.put(src)
71:   }
72: 
73:   def writeCachedString(string: String): Unit = {
74:     val cachedIndex = stringCache.get(string)
75:     if (cachedIndex == null) {
76:       writeInt(stringCacheCurrentIndex)
77:       writeString(string)
78:       stringCache.put(string, stringCacheCurrentIndex)
79:       stringCacheCurrentIndex += 1
80:     } else {
81:       writeInt(-cachedIndex.intValue)
82:     }
83:   }
84: 
85:   def writeString(string: String): Unit =
86:     if (string.isEmpty) {
87:       bb.putInt(0)
88:     } else {
89:       val value = StringInternals.value(string)
90:       val valueLength = value.length
91:       val coder = StringInternals.coder(string)
92:       ensureCapacity(jl.Byte.BYTES + jl.Integer.BYTES + valueLength)
93:       bb.putInt(value.length)
94:       val originalPosition = bb.position
95:       System.arraycopy(value, 0, bb.array, originalPosition, valueLength)
96:       bb.position(originalPosition + valueLength)
97:       bb.put(coder)
98:     }
99: 
100:   def writeInt(l: Int): Unit = {
101:     ensureCapacity(jl.Integer.BYTES)
102:     bb.putInt(l)
103:   }
104: 
105:   def writeLong(l: Long): Unit = {
106:     ensureCapacity(jl.Long.BYTES)
107:     bb.putLong(l)
108:   }
109: 
110:   override def close(): Unit =
111:     try {
112:       flush()
113:       channel.force(true)
114:     } finally {
115:       channel.close()
116:     }
117: }

119: abstract class DataWriterMessageSerializer[T](writer: BufferedFileChannelWriter, header: Byte) {
120: 
121:   def writeGroups(groupHierarchy: List[String]): Unit = {
122:     writer.writeInt(groupHierarchy.length)
123:     groupHierarchy.foreach(writer.writeCachedString)
124:   }
125: 
126:   def serialize(m: T): Unit = {
127:     writer.writeByte(header)
128:     serialize0(m)
129:   }
130: 
131:   protected def serialize0(m: T): Unit
132: }

134: final class RunMessageSerializer(writer: BufferedFileChannelWriter)
135:     extends DataWriterMessageSerializer[(RunMessage, Seq[Assertion], ju.Map[String, Int])](writer, RecordHeader.Run.value) {
136: 
137:   // WARNING do not remove or serialization will happen with a wrong format
138:   import io.gatling.shared.model.assertion.AssertionPicklers._
139: 
140:   import boopickle.Default._
141: 
142:   override protected def serialize0(init: (RunMessage, Seq[Assertion], ju.Map[String, Int])): Unit = {
143:     val (runMessage, assertions, scenarios) = init
144:     import runMessage._
145:     writer.writeString(gatlingVersion)
146:     writer.writeString(simulationClassName)
147:     writer.writeLong(start)
148:     writer.writeString(runDescription)
149:     writer.writeInt(scenarios.size)
150:     scenarios.asScala.toSeq.sortBy(_._2).map(_._1).foreach(writer.writeString)
151:     writer.writeInt(assertions.size)
152:     assertions.foreach { assertion =>
153:       val byteBuffer = Pickle.intoBytes(assertion)
154:       writer.writeByteBuffer(byteBuffer)
155:     }
156:   }
157: }

160:     extends DataWriterMessageSerializer[DataWriterMessage.LoadEvent.User](writer, RecordHeader.User.value) {
161:   override protected def serialize0(user: DataWriterMessage.LoadEvent.User): Unit = {
162:     import user._

170:     extends DataWriterMessageSerializer[DataWriterMessage.LoadEvent.Response](writer, RecordHeader.Request.value) {
171: 
172:   override protected def serialize0(response: DataWriterMessage.LoadEvent.Response): Unit = {
173:     import response._
174:     writeGroups(groupHierarchy)
175:     writer.writeCachedString(name)
176:     writer.writeInt((startTimestamp - runStart).toInt)
177:     writer.writeInt((endTimestamp - runStart).toInt)
178:     writer.writeBoolean(status == OK)
179:     writer.writeCachedString(message.getOrElse(""))
180:   }
181: }

183: class GroupMessageSerializer(writer: BufferedFileChannelWriter, start: Long)
184:     extends DataWriterMessageSerializer[DataWriterMessage.LoadEvent.Group](writer, RecordHeader.Group.value) {
185:   override protected def serialize0(group: DataWriterMessage.LoadEvent.Group): Unit = {
186:     import group._
187:     writeGroups(groupHierarchy)
188:     writer.writeInt((startTimestamp - start).toInt)
189:     writer.writeInt((endTimestamp - start).toInt)
190:     writer.writeInt(cumulatedResponseTime)
191:     writer.writeBoolean(status == OK)
192:   }

195: class ErrorMessageSerializer(writer: BufferedFileChannelWriter, start: Long)
196:     extends DataWriterMessageSerializer[DataWriterMessage.LoadEvent.Error](writer, RecordHeader.Error.value) {
197:   override protected def serialize0(error: DataWriterMessage.LoadEvent.Error): Unit = {
198:     import error._
199:     writer.writeCachedString(message)
200:     writer.writeInt((timestamp - start).toInt)
201:   }
202: }

212: private[gatling] object LogFileDataWriter {
213:   private[gatling] val LogFileName = "simulation.log"
214:   private val BufferSize = 8192
215: 
216:   def logFile(resultsDirectory: Path, runId: String, create: Boolean): Path =
217:     simulationLogDirectory(runId, create, resultsDirectory).resolve(LogFileName)
218: 
219:   def apply(
220:       runMessage: RunMessage,
221:       scenarios: Seq[ShortScenarioDescription],
222:       assertions: Seq[Assertion],
223:       resultsDirectory: Path
224:   ): LogFileDataWriter = {
225:     StringInternals.checkAvailability()
226:     val simulationLog = LogFileDataWriter.logFile(resultsDirectory, runMessage.runId, create = true)
227:     val channel = new RandomAccessFile(simulationLog.toFile, "rw").getChannel
228:     val bb = ByteBuffer.allocate(BufferSize)
229:     val writer = new BufferedFileChannelWriter(channel, bb)
230:     val scenariosMap = new ju.HashMap[String, Int]
231:     scenarios.map(_.name).zipWithIndex.foreach { case (scenario, index) =>
232:       scenariosMap.put(scenario, index)
233:     }
234: 
235:     new LogFileDataWriter(
236:       runMessage,
237:       scenariosMap,
238:       assertions,
239:       writer
240:     )
241:   }
242: }
243: 
244: private[gatling] final class LogFileDataWriter private (
245:     runMessage: RunMessage,
246:     scenariosMap: ju.HashMap[String, Int],
247:     assertions: Seq[Assertion],
248:     writer: BufferedFileChannelWriter
249: ) extends DataWriter[FileData]("file-data-writer") {
250: 
251:   override def onInit(): FileData = {
252:     new RunMessageSerializer(writer).serialize(runMessage, assertions, scenariosMap)
253: 
254:     new FileData(
255:       new UserMessageSerializer(writer, runMessage.start, scenariosMap),
256:       new ResponseMessageSerializer(writer, runMessage.start),
257:       new GroupMessageSerializer(writer, runMessage.start),
258:       new ErrorMessageSerializer(writer, runMessage.start),
259:       writer
260:     )
261:   }
262: 
263:   override def onFlush(data: FileData): Unit = {}
264: 
265:   override def onMessage(message: DataWriterMessage.LoadEvent, data: FileData): Unit =
266:     message match {
267:       case user: DataWriterMessage.LoadEvent.User         => data.userMessageSerializer.serialize(user)
268:       case group: DataWriterMessage.LoadEvent.Group       => data.groupMessageSerializer.serialize(group)
269:       case response: DataWriterMessage.LoadEvent.Response => data.responseMessageSerializer.serialize(response)
270:       case error: DataWriterMessage.LoadEvent.Error       => data.errorMessageSerializer.serialize(error)
271:     }
272: 
273:   override def onCrash(cause: String, data: FileData): Unit = {}
274: 
275:   override def onStop(data: FileData): Unit =
276:     data.writer.close()
277: }
